items.summary: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，据蓝鲸新闻报道，在阿里巴巴今天（19 日）召开的 2027 财年第二季度业绩电话会上，阿里巴巴集团 CEO 吴泳铭表示，全球各个区域的算力政策出现了非常大的变化，将对阿里云的数据中心建设产生影响。 吴泳铭透露，根据目前的初步评估，阿里此前制定的到 2032 年全球数据中心规模 超过 20GW 的目标有可能下调 ，资本开支可能有一定程度降低。 同时，阿里将在国产算力及相关供应链上投入更积极，推进整体计划。基于平头哥的算力供应链持续放量节奏，2027 年和 2028 年上半年将是阿里最大的一个持续投资阶段。吴泳铭另表示，对于长期的现金流规划非常有信心。 据IT之家此前报道，吴泳铭表示， 2027 年和 2028 年，将是中国算力最紧缺的两年 。2027 年以后，阿里云的芯片供给都会以国产平头哥芯片为主，同时也会采购其他国产芯片来支持内部的推理需求。 相关阅读： 《 阿里巴巴 CEO 吴泳铭：2027、2028 年将是中国算力最紧缺的两年 》

items.title: Elon Musk’s SpaceXAI suffers chemical spill at Mississippi AI data center
items.summary: A chemical spill at a SpaceXAI facility in Southaven saw the Mississippi Department of Environmental Quality (MDEQ) get involved, with between 5,000 and 6,000 gallons of propylene glycol confirmed to have spilled. The chemical is a heat transfer fluid used in a variety of products, such as antifreeze. The chemical ultimately found its way into a drainage ditch, but MDEQ has told residents that there is no immediate threat to their health or safety, according to local news reports . items.title: Global OLED monitor shipments doubled year-over-year in Q3 2026
items.summary: Global OLED monitor shipments doubled year over year in the third quarter of 2026, according to the latest market research from TrendForce. Shipments also increased 13% sequentially, reflecting strong demand for OLED displays and improving panel availability. While the market's rapid growth is impressive regardless, there are good reasons why OLED monitors are becoming increasingly popular: they're getting cheaper, better, and considerably easier to justify .
